sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursTooltip:
How business hours are applied to this connection:
- Follow company hours: uses the company hours (and the queue, if any).
- Ignore hours: open 24/7.
- Queue hours only: ignores the company hours and holidays; follows only the hours set on the queue this connection routes to (no queue hours = open 24/7).

sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursModeEnabledDesc: The connection is open 24/7: ignores both company and queue hours.
sessoesPage.ignoreBusinessHoursModeQueueOnlyDesc: Ignores the company hours and holidays; attendance is controlled only by the queue hours. With no queue hours, open 24/7.

sessoesPage.queuePositionEnabledHint: Notifies the customer of their position when a ticket enters the queue.
sessoesPage.queuePositionTooltip:
When a new ticket enters the queue as pending, the system sends an automatic message informing the customer of their position and the average waiting time.

Inherit: follows the tenant's global setting.
Enabled: overrides the global and uses this channel's setting.
Disabled: overrides the global and does not send.

The trigger fires only once per ticket, after the chatbot/flow finishes. If the ticket is auto-assigned to an agent or a chatbot takes over, the message is not sent.

Position scope: counted within the ticket's queue; if no queue, counted by channel. Supported channels: WhatsApp Web, Baileys, WABA, Instagram, Messenger, Webchat, Telegram, Evolution, Z-API, UazAPI, Meow, Hub.

customProfiles.title: Access Profiles

help.description: Create reusable permission templates. Each profile can be assigned to many users with profile=custom.

s0.title: How it works
s0.i0: Create a profile with a descriptive name (ex: Night Agent).
s0.i1: Pick sidebar-visible modules and action permissions (buttons, exports, etc.).
s0.i2: Then in Users, pick profile=custom and select this profile.

s1.title: Use AI
s1.i0: Describe what the user needs to do in plain language.
s1.i1: Copilot will suggest permissions in seconds.
s1.i2: Always review the toggles before saving — defaults are safe.

s2.title: Important rules
s2.i0: A profile used by 1+ user cannot be deleted. Reassign first.
s2.i1: Profile changes propagate in realtime to all linked users via socket.

provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpTitle: How to set up the injector (step by step)
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpIntro: Sidecar that connects the channel WITHOUT a QR code by injecting the session straight into the database. One per server (not per user). Code in extra/evo-passkey-injector.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep1: Add the evo-injector service to your Evolution/Evolution Go docker-compose, on the same network as Postgres, using the image zdgzpro/evo-passkey-injector:latest. Ready-made block in docker-compose.example.yml.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep2: Generate a strong secret with openssl rand -hex 32 and set it in INJECTOR_SECRET.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep3Evo: Enable Evolution API by filling the internal Postgres DSN in EVO_DATABASE_URI (the database is never exposed).
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep3Evogo: Enable Evolution Go by filling the two internal DSNs in EVOGO_AUTH_DATABASE_URI and EVOGO_USERS_DATABASE_URI (the database is never exposed).
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep4: Bring the sidecar up with docker compose up -d evo-injector and confirm on GET /health that the backend is enabled.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpStep5: Paste the injector URL above (same host: http://127.0.0.1:8082; separate host: use HTTPS/reverse-proxy) and the same INJECTOR_SECRET in the Secret field.
provedoresGlobaisPage.injectorHelpNote: Using both channels on the same sidecar? Point both screens to the same URL and the same secret.

deleteBanned.s1Remote: This number is not in THIS installation (shared license). The system will try to DEREGISTER it at Meta via the Techprovider app — the channel stops working even in another installation — and remove it from the central score monitor. The channel record in the other installation is not deleted (remove it there once you locate it). Own App channels are not affected (Meta rejects our app). To reactivate later: reconnect the channel entering the 6-digit PIN (two-step verification) — a Meta-banned number only comes back if the ban is reverted.
deleteBanned.s1RemoteRev: Blocks the number at Meta + removes from monitor
deleteBanned.s4RemoteDone: Done: number removed from the central monitor and score recalculated. If the Meta deregistration failed (number already deregistered or Own App) and the channel remains active in another installation, it returns to the monitor on the next automatic report.
deleteBanned.otherInstall: This number is not in this installation. If the license is shared, it may belong to another installation — delete it from that panel (or it was already removed).

deleteBanned.s1Title: What will be deleted and from where
deleteBanned.s1Intro: Read carefully. Each item shows whether the action is reversible.
deleteBanned.s1Local: Our system (Z-PRO): the channel, sessions and settings will be deleted.
deleteBanned.s1Bm: Our Business Manager: we unlink our app from your WABA/Page/Instagram. The number leaves our score.
deleteBanned.s1Dereg: Meta hosting: the number is deregistered from the Cloud API and becomes free to re-register.
deleteBanned.s1DeregRev: Reversible with PIN (a banned number may not come back — Meta's decision)
deleteBanned.s1OwnApp: This channel uses Own App: we do NOT touch Meta — we only remove it from our system. Manage the number in your own Business Manager.
deleteBanned.s1NotRemoved: Note: the WABA and the number are NOT deleted from Meta's Business Manager via API — that is only possible in WhatsApp Manager (manual). We show the steps at the end.
deleteBanned.s1NoUnblock: Deleting does not re-enable Meta connections immediately: re-enabling new connections follows the cooldown period (or manual release).
deleteBanned.s1Accept: I have read and understood what will be deleted and from where.
deleteBanned.s2Title: Confirm that you are the license holder

deleteBanned.s4Manual: Open WhatsApp Manager > Account settings > Phone numbers, select the number and click Delete (it asks for the Business Manager password).

flowBuilderNodeForm.agentTakeoverNote: The agent takes over the conversation from this point on.

flowBuilderNodeForm.condVariableHint: Compares a flow/contact variable, not the message. Routes as soon as the value matches — including right after an API block — and comes BEFORE text conditions. On a node that collects an answer, only when the reply arrives.
flowBuilderNodeForm.webhookResponseHint: With routing set, the flow jumps to the chosen step based on the HTTP result (2xx = success).

flowBuilderNodeForm.notifyMessagePh: E.g.: Hot lead: '{{name}}' reached step X
flowBuilderNodeForm.pixPaymentLinkHint: On these channels PIX is sent as copy-paste text + a button with this link. Without a link, only the text is sent.
flowBuilderNodeForm.templateFallbackHint: The template is sent on WABA/Gupshup/Dialog360 channels; elsewhere the body text is sent as a plain message.
flowBuilderNodeForm.condAutoHint: Sends the node's interactions and runs the action immediately, without waiting for the customer's reply.
flowBuilderNodeForm.variableBlockedByAuto: An automatic node cannot capture a variable — capturing requires the customer's reply.
flowBuilderNodeForm.variableValidationHint: Responses that don't match the format make the bot ask again up to the limit; after that the value is captured anyway.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action1QueueAutoDistHint: When the customer arrives here via the bot, this step decides the queue. If the queue has Automatic Distribution, it will pick the agent respecting the load limit.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action2UserAutoDistHint: This action assigns the conversation to the chosen agent directly — it ignores the load limit and the queue's Automatic Distribution.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action3CloseAutoDistHint: When ending the conversation, the agent's slot opens up. In queues with Automatic Distribution, this may trigger delivery of a conversation that was waiting.
flowBuilderNodeForm.action4ChannelAutoDistHint: Conversations moved to another channel follow the destination queue's rules — including Automatic Distribution if configured there.
flowBuilderNodeForm.stepRepresentsInitialContact: This step represents the initial contact
flowBuilderNodeForm.warning1: Interactions are executed in order, top to bottom.

flowBuilderNodeForm.warning5: Avoid infinite loops between steps without an exit condition.

aiAgents.actionsNote: The agent tags the contact and moves them along the funnel on its own during the conversation, whenever what the customer says matches the situation you describe. The conversation carries on normally.
aiAgents.actionTypeTag: Apply a tag to the contact
aiAgents.actionTypeKanban: Move the contact along the funnel
aiAgents.actionTagsEmpty: No tags registered. Create tags to use this type of action.
aiAgents.actionKanbansEmpty: No funnel stage registered. Create the funnel stages to use this type of action.
aiAgents.actionWhenPlaceholder: When the customer says they want to buy or asks for a quote
aiAgents.actionWhenHint: Describe the moment in the conversation when this action should happen. This is the sentence the agent uses to recognise the right time.
aiAgents.actionMessagePlaceholder: Got it, I have noted that here.
aiAgents.actionMessageHint: Sent only when the agent performs the action without writing anything alongside it, so the customer is never left without a reply.
aiAgents.actionMessageDefaultPlaceholder: All right, I have recorded that.
aiAgents.actionMessageDefaultHint: Applies to any action without its own message. Without it, the action may happen silently.
aiAgents.actionsIncomplete: Complete the actions: choose the destination and fill in the When to use field.
aiAgents.memoryNote: The agent writes down on the contact record whatever the customer shares during the conversation, so whoever takes over later already finds everything filled in.
aiAgents.memoryEnabled: Record data on the contact record
aiAgents.memoryPanelNote: If someone has the contact record open and saves it afterwards, whatever the agent noted in the meantime may be overwritten.
aiAgents.memoryFieldDescriptionPlaceholder: Customer e-mail for sending the proposal
aiAgents.memoryFieldInvalidName: Name not accepted. Use letters and numbers; some names are reserved by the system.
aiAgents.memoryMax: Limit of {max} data entries per agent.
aiAgents.memoryFieldsIncomplete: Review the names of the data to record: one of them is not accepted.
aiAgents.errInvalidActions: Review the agent actions: the server did not accept the configuration sent.
aiAgents.errInvalidMemoryFields: Review the data to record: the server did not accept the configuration sent.
aiAgents.actionsUnsupportedBackend: Agent saved, but this server does not support Actions and Data to record yet. Update the system to use these features.
aiAgents.helpS3I0: On the Actions tab, set up what the agent does on its own during the chat: tag the contact or move them in the funnel. Fill in the When to use field carefully.
aiAgents.helpS3I1: Under Data to record, list what the agent should note on the contact record, such as e-mail, city or interest. The team sees it all when taking over.
aiAgents.toolsNote: Connect the agent to an external automation: when the customer asks for something that needs a lookup, the agent calls the automation and answers with the result.
aiAgents.toolsPayloadHint: Each lookup sends the conversation data (ticket, contact and what the agent needs to know) and the answer is used in the reply to the customer.
aiAgents.toolUrlHint: Address that receives the lookup and returns the answer. For safety, internal network addresses only work if allowed in Settings.
aiAgents.toolSecretPlaceholder: Sent with the lookup so your automation can verify it
aiAgents.toolDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: when the customer asks for the status of an order by its number
aiAgents.toolDescriptionHint: Explain when to use this tool - the AI reads this description to decide.
aiAgents.toolParamsHint: Leave empty for the agent to send the customer question as free text.
aiAgents.paramDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: order number given by the customer
aiAgents.toolsIncomplete: Fill in the name, address and when to use of every tool, or remove the incomplete ones.
aiAgents.targetsEmptyWarning: With no destinations the agent cannot transfer: it may tell the customer it will forward the conversation and keep answering instead.
aiAgents.targetTransferMessagePlaceholder: E.g.: All set! I have forwarded you to the right team.
aiAgents.targetTransferMessageHint: Sent only after the transfer actually happens, when the agent writes nothing.
aiAgents.transferMessagePlaceholder: E.g.: I have forwarded your conversation to the team. Someone will continue shortly.
aiAgents.transferMessageHint: Applies to destinations without their own message. Keeps the customer from being left without a reply at the moment of the transfer.
aiAgents.maxHistoryHint: How many previous messages the agent considers in each reply. Default: 20.
aiAgents.temperatureHint: 0 makes answers more predictable; higher values make them more varied.
aiAgents.sourcesNote: Bring in the content you already have: documents, pages from your website or a spreadsheet of questions and answers.
aiAgents.sourceDocHint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV or TXT — up to 10MB. The text in the file is read and indexed; scanned documents (no text) are not accepted.
aiAgents.sourceDocHintV6: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, JSON or Markdown (.md) — up to 10MB. The text in the file is read and indexed; scanned documents (no text) are not accepted.
aiAgents.sourceSyncDailyNote: Once a day the page is read again and the content is updated if it has changed.
aiAgents.sourceDeleteConfirmDesc: The excerpts it generated will no longer be used in the agent's answers.
aiAgents.sourceErrorGeneric: This source could not be processed.
aiAgents.semanticNote: The agent understands synonyms and the meaning of the question, not just the exact words. Uses the agent's own AI key.
aiAgents.urlHint: The visible text of the page is read and indexed. Pages that load content via script are not read.
aiAgents.urlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
aiAgents.faqColumnsNote: In CSV: column 1 = question, column 2 = answer.
aiAgents.faqFileHint: CSV or TXT file with one question and one answer per line, or a JSON file with the list of questions and answers.
aiAgents.faqJsonHint: In JSON: a list of objects with "question" and "answer".
aiAgents.faqJsonInvalid: Could not read the JSON. Use a list of objects with a question and an answer.
aiAgents.faqTooLarge: Content too large to import at once (maximum {max}).
aiAgents.faqPastePlaceholder: Do you deliver same day?;Yes, for orders placed before 2pm.
aiAgents.errFileTooLarge: File is larger than the 10MB limit.
aiAgents.errSourceParse: The file content could not be read.
aiAgents.errSourceNoText: The file has no readable text (scanned documents are not accepted).
aiAgents.errSourceFetch: The page could not be reached.
aiAgents.errSourceLimit: The agent's content limit has been reached.
aiAgents.errSourceDuplicate: This content has already been imported for this agent.
aiAgents.errSourceBusy: Another import is in progress. Try again in a moment.
aiAgents.errSourceResyncUnsupported: This source type cannot be reprocessed.
aiAgents.title: AI Agents
aiAgents.description: Create smart pre-service agents: they answer based on your content, follow the service style you define and transfer the conversation to the right team.
aiAgents.helpDesc: Set up AI agents that serve your customers automatically before the team.
aiAgents.helpS0I0: Click New Agent and set the name, instructions and service style.
aiAgents.helpS0I1: Enter the AI key and model in the Provider tab.
aiAgents.helpS0I2: Activate the agent when it is ready.
aiAgents.helpS1I0: Add articles with your business information.
aiAgents.helpS1I1: The agent uses these articles to answer customer questions.
aiAgents.helpS2I0: Link the agent to a channel in Connections or use the AI Agent block in the flow builder.
aiAgents.helpS2I1: Define transfer destinations so the AI routes each subject to the right team.
aiAgents.unavailableBanner: Feature unavailable in this server version. Update the system to use AI Agents.
aiAgents.emptyHint: Create your first AI agent to serve customers automatically.
aiAgents.deleteConfirmDesc: Channels and flows using this agent will stop triggering it. Ongoing conversations with it will be released to the team.
aiAgents.knowledgeSaveFirst: Save the agent to add the knowledge base.
aiAgents.systemPromptPlaceholder: E.g.: You are the virtual assistant of a pet shop. Be friendly, use simple language and answer questions about products and services.
aiAgents.systemPromptHint: Describe how the agent should behave: personality, what it may or may not say and how to treat the customer.
aiAgents.exitKeywordHint: When the customer sends exactly this word, the agent stops and the conversation goes to the team.
aiAgents.apiKeyKeptPlaceholder: Current key kept — type to replace
aiAgents.apiKeyHint: AI provider access key (stored securely on the server). If the key expires or the account runs out of credit, the agent transfers the conversation and leaves a note on the ticket.
aiAgents.modelHint: AI model used in the replies.
aiAgents.targetsIncomplete: Complete the transfer destinations or remove the incomplete ones.
aiAgents.kbNote: With the base enabled, the agent answers using the articles below as its main source.
aiAgents.articleContentHint: Write the information as you would explain it to the customer.
aiAgents.articleDeleteDesc: The agent will stop using this content in its answers.
aiAgents.knowledgeEmptyHint: Add articles with frequently asked questions and your business information.
aiAgents.routingNote: The AI identifies the subject of the conversation and transfers it to the right destination at the right time.
aiAgents.targetDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: payments, invoices, receipts and charges
aiAgents.targetDescriptionHint: Explain when to transfer here — the AI reads this description to decide.
aiAgents.autoSummaryNote: When transferring, the agent records a conversation summary as an internal note for the team.
aiAgents.fallbackQueueNote: If the AI fails (including an invalid key or no credit), the conversation goes to this queue instead of being left unanswered, with a note on the ticket explaining why.
aiAgents.errKbTooLarge: The article exceeds the maximum allowed size.
aiAgents.duplicateUnavailable: This server cannot duplicate agents yet. Update the system.
aiAgents.mapSubtitle: Read-only view of what has been set up. To change it, use Edit.
aiAgents.mapChannelsHint: Link the agent to a channel or use the AI Agent block in the flow.
aiAgents.mapKnowledgeEmpty: No content in the knowledge base
aiAgents.actionsTabIntro: The agent runs these actions on its own during the conversation, whenever the situation you describe in When to use happens.
aiAgents.actionTypeBlock: Stop the AI for this contact
aiAgents.actionOpportunityNamePh: Leave empty to use the contact name
aiAgents.actionOpportunityNoDup: If the contact already has an open opportunity in this funnel, no new one is created.
aiAgents.actionNoteContentPh: E.g. Customer asked for a quote
aiAgents.actionNoteLimit: Up to 3 notes per conversation. They show up on the Notes tab.
aiAgents.actionNotifyOnce: Each alert fires once per conversation.
aiAgents.actionNotifyNoTarget: Pick a queue or at least one agent.
aiAgents.actionBlockNote: The AI hands the conversation to the emergency queue and stops answering this contact. To undo it, unblock the chatbot on the contact record.
aiAgents.actionBlockNeedsFallback: Pick a fallback queue on the Routing tab to use this action.
aiAgents.actionAiWrites: The AI completes this text with what the customer said.
aiAgents.serverIgnoredActions: Agent saved, but this server does not run some of the new actions yet. Update the system to use them.
aiAgents.serverIgnoredTargets: Agent saved, but this server does not accept the Flow destination yet. Update the system to use it.
aiAgents.mapActionBlock: Stops the AI for the contact
aiAgents.errInvalidCloseRules: Check the closing rules: the reason or the grace period is incomplete.
aiAgents.errInvalidNativeTools: Check the calendar and the scheduled message: the page or the service is missing.
aiAgents.errBlockNeedsFallback: Pick an emergency queue on the Routing tab before using the action that stops the AI.
aiAgents.errInvalidTimezone: Invalid time zone. Use a name such as America/Sao_Paulo.
aiAgents.targetFlowNote: The conversation continues in the chosen flow, which starts right away. With this destination the AI does not send a goodbye message.
aiAgents.targetFlowUnavailable: This server does not offer the Flow destination yet.
aiAgents.targetAiAgentNote: The chosen AI agent takes over the conversation and replies to the customer's message right away, with no goodbye from this agent. Up to 3 hand-offs between AI agents per conversation; after that, the conversation goes to the fallback queue.
aiAgents.serverIgnoredAiAgentTargets: Agent saved, but this server does not accept the Another AI agent destination yet. Update the system to use it.
aiAgents.consultDescription: Before replying, this agent can ask another AI agent a question. This agent is still the one who replies to the customer.
aiAgents.consultWhenPlaceholder: E.g.: questions about prices, delivery times or payment methods
aiAgents.consultCostNote: Each consultation is one more AI call, made with the consulted agent's key. It answers only with its own instructions and knowledge base, without running actions. Up to 2 consultations per message.
aiAgents.errInvalidConsult: Review the AI agents to consult: the server did not accept the configuration sent.
aiAgents.closeReasonsLabel: Reasons the AI can choose from
aiAgents.closeReasonsNote: When closing the conversation, the AI picks one of these reasons. With none selected, it closes without a reason, as it does today.
aiAgents.graceEnable: Hold the customer for a while
aiAgents.graceNote: If the agent closes the conversation and the customer comes back within this time, the chat goes straight to the chosen destination, skipping the AI.
aiAgents.bookingEnable: Let the AI check times and book
aiAgents.bookingServiceNeedsForm: This service has required form questions and cannot be booked by the AI yet.
aiAgents.bookingProfessionalNote: On a page with professionals, the first one available in the page order is used.
aiAgents.bookingPhoneOnly: The calendar is only offered on phone-based channels and outside groups.
aiAgents.bookingConfirmNote: The confirmation with the link to cancel or reschedule is sent by the booking page itself.
aiAgents.bookingTimezoneDiffers: The agent time zone differs from the booking page time zone. Times are converted to the agent time zone before reaching the customer.
aiAgents.bookingNotInPlan: The booking page is not included in this company plan.
aiAgents.timezoneNote: Used to understand dates said in the conversation, such as tomorrow at 10. If left empty, America/Sao_Paulo is used.
aiAgents.scheduleEnable: Let the AI schedule a message for later
aiAgents.scheduleNote: The AI only schedules when the customer asks, always within this window.
aiAgents.scheduleOfficialNote: On official channels, only within 24 hours.
aiAgents.scheduleNoCancel: The message is sent even if the customer replies before it.
aiAgents.scheduleNewTicketNote: If the conversation is already closed, the customer reply opens a new one.
aiAgents.scheduleNotInPlan: Scheduled messages are not included in this company plan.
aiAgents.helpS4I0: On the Actions tab, the agent records an opportunity in the funnel, stage and owner you choose.
aiAgents.helpS4I1: It also leaves a note on the conversation and alerts the queue or the people you choose, without stopping the chat.
aiAgents.helpS4I2: The stop-answering action takes the contact away from the agent and sends the chat to the Emergency queue, so it is only available once that queue is set.
aiAgents.helpS5I0: With Calendar enabled on the Tools tab, the agent shows the free times from your booking page and books the one the customer picks.
aiAgents.helpS5I1: With scheduled message enabled, it sets up a follow-up for the agreed date, such as a reminder before the appointment.
aiAgents.helpS1I2: Besides articles, you can import documents (PDF, Word, spreadsheet, text, JSON or Markdown), web page links and FAQs in CSV or JSON.
aiAgents.helpS6I0: In the Routing tab, the Another AI agent destination hands the conversation over to a specialist AI agent, which replies to the customer's message right away.
aiAgents.helpS6I1: Up to 3 hand-offs between AI agents per conversation. After that, the conversation goes to the fallback queue.
aiAgents.helpS6I2: In the Tools tab, under Consult other AI agents, the agent asks a specialist before replying, without handing over the conversation. Each consultation is one more AI call.
aiAgents.consultWhenHint: Explain when to consult each AI agent — the AI reads this description to decide.

configGeralPage.aiAgentPrivateWebhookDesc: Lets AI Agent tools reach addresses on your internal network.
configGeralPage.aiAgentPrivateWebhookNote: Turn on only if your automation runs on the same server or on your private network. When off, only public addresses are accepted.
configGeralPage.notifyOnlyHumanTicketsDesc: When enabled, the notification sound and popup do not fire while the ticket is in the chatbot (automatic flow). You are alerted only when the ticket moves to a human agent (pending in a queue or assigned).
configGeralPage.notifyOnlyHumanTicketsNote: How it works: while the ticket is in the chatbot (automatic flow active, still without a queue or agent), the sound and popup stay muted. When the flow routes the ticket to a queue or assigns it to an agent, notifications resume. The ticket list and the bell keep updating.
configGeralPage.crossChannelTicketCheckDesc: When starting conversations, warns if the same contact already has an open or pending ticket on another channel. In mass dispatches, contacts already in a conversation or waiting do NOT receive the dispatch.
configGeralPage.crossChannelTicketCheckNote: How it works: the check matches the contact's number across all of the tenant's WhatsApp channels. In conversations (New Conversation, Contacts, Kanban and Pending) it shows a warning and never blocks. In Mass Dispatch and campaigns, contacts with an open or waiting ticket do NOT receive the message — they appear as skipped in the summary and the dispatch owner gets a notification.
configGeralPage.aiEngineDesc: Which OpenAI API the assistants use: Automatic uses the new engine (Responses) and keeps old tickets on the legacy one until they close. The Assistants API shuts down on 08/26/2026.
configGeralPage.scheduleRoutingWindowDesc: When a scheduled message has a queue/user configured, the contact's reply within this window goes straight to the destination, skipping the chatbot. 0 = disabled.
configGeralPage.autoDisableIntegrationsOnAcceptDesc: When accepting a pending ticket, automatically turns off the ticket's bots and AI integrations
configGeralPage.autoDistEnabledTitle: Automatic Distribution active in some queue
configGeralPage.autoDistEnabledDesc: The settings below marked with a notice interact with Automatic Distribution by Queue — for conversations in queues with the option enabled, some rules on this page are ignored or adjusted. Hover over each item to understand the effect.
configGeralPage.forcarAdminAutoDistNote: In queues with Automatic Distribution enabled, this option is ignored for conversations of that queue — the queue picks the agent respecting the load limit.
configGeralPage.directTicketsToWalletsAutoDistNote: Customers with a fixed agent (wallet) always go to their agent, with priority over the queue's Automatic Distribution — even if the agent is at the limit.
configGeralPage.transbordoAutoDistNote: When wallet transfer is enabled, it takes priority over the queue's Automatic Distribution.
configGeralPage.reopenTicketAssignsToActorAutoDistNote: In queues with Automatic Distribution, reopened conversations return to the waiting queue to be redistributed respecting the limit — they do not go directly to whoever reopened.
configGeralPage.title: General Settings
configGeralPage.queuePositionGlobalEnabledLabel: Enable queue position for all channels
configGeralPage.queuePositionGlobalEnabledHint: Notifies the customer of their position when a ticket enters the queue. Channels can override individually.
configGeralPage.queuePositionAvgHint: Value shown to the customer in the message.
configGeralPage.queuePositionMessagePlaceholder:
Hello {{name}}! You are #{{position}} in the queue.
Average waiting time is about {{avgWait}} minutes.
Thank you for your patience.
configGeralPage.resetFlowMsg: Do you want to reset the active flow for new sessions?
configGeralPage.forceMessageMsg: This command will send stuck messages in the system.
configGeralPage.forceMessageDesc: This command will send stuck messages in the system.
configGeralPage.resolveMessagesMsg: This command will remove messages with errors from the system.
configGeralPage.resolveMessagesDesc: This command will remove messages with errors from the system.
configGeralPage.validateContactsMsg: Caution: many contacts may cause WhatsApp blocking. Validate all contacts in bulk?
configGeralPage.validateContactsDesc: This command will validate the number of all contacts in the system.
configGeralPage.syncMessagesMsg: Do you want to update the dates of synced messages?
configGeralPage.syncMessagesDesc: This option updates imported message dates to their original timestamp.
configGeralPage.syncTicketsMsg: Do you want to update ticket dates to the latest message time?
configGeralPage.syncTicketsDesc: This option updates ticket dates to the latest message timestamp.
configGeralPage.normalizeBirthdaysDesc: Standardizes contacts' birthday dates to YYYY-MM-DD, fixing imported or legacy records where the day and month may be swapped (which makes the birthday message fire on the wrong day).
configGeralPage.normalizeBirthdaysMsg: This goes through this tenant's contacts and standardizes the birthday dates. Dates that cannot be safely interpreted are kept as-is. Do you want to continue?
configGeralPage.scanContactsMsg: This process will scan the entire database and update contacts without LID. May take time on large databases.
configGeralPage.scanContactsDesc: This option will start searching and updating contacts without LID.
configGeralPage.lidConsolidationDesc: Detects and merges contact pairs duplicated by LID/PN cross-collision. Destructive operation — backup required.
configGeralPage.instagramPkSanitizeDesc: Detects Instagram contacts with instagramPK corrupted by JSON parser overflow and fixes them by cross-referencing the Meta API.
configGeralPage.leaveMessage: You changed settings that have not been saved yet. If you leave now, they will be lost.
configGeralPage.ticketsVisibilityDesc: Control who can see which tickets
configGeralPage.notViewAssignedTickets: Do not view tickets already assigned to other users
configGeralPage.notViewAssignedTicketsDesc: Only the ticket owner and admins can view.
configGeralPage.notViewTicketsChatBotDesc: No user can see tickets handled by the ChatBot.
configGeralPage.directTicketsToWalletsDesc: Directs attendance to customer wallet owners.
configGeralPage.ticketNulo: View tickets without assigned user or queue
configGeralPage.ticketNuloDesc: All users will see attendances without assigned user or queue.
configGeralPage.supervisorChannelScopedDesc: When enabled, the supervisor keeps elevated privileges (sees other agents' queues and tickets) but only sees tickets from the channels assigned to them. No effect when the supervisor is already limited to a regular user.
configGeralPage.customProfileEnabledDesc: Allows creating reusable custom access profiles for users with profile=custom.
configGeralPage.userPaymentsEnabledDesc: When enabled, regular agents can also send the charge template (Pix, link or bank slip) using the channel key. When off, only administrators and supervisors can charge.
configGeralPage.privacidadeFunilDesc: When enabled, regular users and supervisors only see their own opportunities. Pipelines, actions and logs are restricted to admins.
configGeralPage.semRedisDesc: Messages will be sent without cadencing.
configGeralPage.botFlowActiveDesc: Flow to be used by the Bot for new attendances
configGeralPage.ignoreGroupMsgDesc: System will not open tickets for groups.
configGeralPage.ignorarStoriesDesc: When enabled, Instagram Stories will be ignored.
configGeralPage.mostrarGruposParaTodosDesc: When enabled, Groups will be visible to all users.
configGeralPage.mostrarFechadoParaTodosDesc: When enabled, Closed attendances will be visible to all users.
configGeralPage.rejectCallsDesc: Audio and video calls will receive the message below.
configGeralPage.chatbotLaneDesc: Adds a tab to the service screen with conversations where a chatbot, an AI agent or an integration (ChatGPT, Typebot, N8N and others) is turned on.
configGeralPage.fixarConexao: Pin connections at the top of attendance
configGeralPage.fixarConexaoDesc: Connections will be pinned at the top instead of floating in the footer.
configGeralPage.forcarPendente: Force current user when changing pending attendance status
configGeralPage.forcarPendenteDesc: The ticket will keep the associated user when status changes from open to pending.
configGeralPage.agruparTicketsDesc: Shows all messages associated with the channel and contact.
configGeralPage.messageListingTypeDesc: Defines how messages are listed in the history.
configGeralPage.messageListingTypeNote: Default follows the Group Tickets option. By Queue: the agent sees only messages from their queues. Complete: everyone sees the contact's full history. By Ticket: only the current service. By User: each agent sees only their own conversation, hiding other agents' replies and notes (admin and supervisor-admin see everything).
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNotice: Notify in history when a scheduled message is sent
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNoticeDesc: Marks in the conversation the moment the scheduled message was sent.
configGeralPage.scheduleSentNoticeNote: Inserts a notice in the conversation when the scheduled message goes out, so the customer's reply makes sense in order.
configGeralPage.videoConferenceProviderDesc: Defines the link sent when using the video call button in the chat. Google Meet requires Google Calendar configured.
configGeralPage.listarPelaUltimaMensagemDesc: When enabled, attendances are listed by last received message.
configGeralPage.ordemReversaListaDesc: Tenant setting: oldest to newest. Request param: orderAsc=true does the same. Otherwise, default order applies.
configGeralPage.validateContactDesc: When enabled, the system validates the contact number (WABA).
configGeralPage.brPhoneConventionDesc: Sets how the system automatically fixes the 9th digit of Brazilian mobile numbers when creating contacts and sending messages.
configGeralPage.brPhoneConventionNote: Area code rule: adds the 9 for area codes below 30 and removes it for 30 or above (historical behavior). Always with 9: mobile numbers always keep the 9th digit, which is never removed — recommended for current numbers. If a message fails because the number does not exist, the system automatically retries with the other 9th-digit variant. With Validate Contact turned off, no automatic correction is applied.
configGeralPage.userCreationPasswordModeDesc: Defines how newly created users receive their first access password.
configGeralPage.userCreationPasswordModeNote: Set by admin: you type the password and share it with the user (default). Change on first login: you set a temporary password and the user must create their own password the first time they sign in. Email invite: the form does not ask for a password — the user receives an email link (valid for 7 days) to create their own password. Email options require SMTP to be configured.
configGeralPage.hearHubApiDesc: When enabled, all messages are created via HUB API with system user.
configGeralPage.ticketsRainDesc: Filter before processing, ignoring tickets not belonging to the user. Recommended for high volume.
configGeralPage.carteiraExterna: Disable external integrations when wallet is active
configGeralPage.carteiraExternaDesc: When enabled, external integrations like ChatGPT and Typebot are disabled when wallet is active.
configGeralPage.walletShowAll: Allow all agents to see wallet contacts
configGeralPage.walletShowAllDesc: When enabled, all agents can view and search contacts even if they are assigned to another user's wallet.
configGeralPage.contactDeleteAdminOnly: Allow only admins to delete contacts
configGeralPage.contactDeleteAdminOnlyDesc: When enabled, only administrators can delete contacts. Supervisors and regular agents will not see the delete button.
configGeralPage.hidePaymentsFromUsers: Hide payment info from regular users (privacy)
configGeralPage.hidePaymentsFromUsersDesc: When enabled, only administrators can see subscription, invoices and billing alerts. Recommended for data privacy compliance — regular users should not see the contractor's financial data.
configGeralPage.inboundByQueueOnlyDesc: When enabled, agents receive incoming tickets based solely on assigned queues (no channel link required). Outbound (New Conversation) still requires the channel linked to the user.
configGeralPage.reopenTicketAssignsToActorDesc: When enabled, reopening a ticket closed by another agent reassigns it to the user who clicked Reopen, instead of keeping it with the previous agent.
configGeralPage.youtubeCommentsCreateTicketsDesc: When enabled, each new YouTube video comment creates a support ticket. Disable to manage comments only via the /youtube-comentarios page without flooding the queue.
configGeralPage.esperarProcessamento: Enable wait in message processing with external integrations
configGeralPage.esperarProcessamentoDesc: When more than one message is received, new messages are only processed after the first is answered.
configGeralPage.transbordoDesc: Overflows wallet attendances if user is offline.
configGeralPage.janelaConversa: Enable WABA message sending outside window
configGeralPage.janelaConversaDesc: Enables WABA message sending after any template, even if the conversation window is not open.
configGeralPage.atualizarNomes: Do not update name when receiving messages
configGeralPage.atualizarNomesDesc: Does not update contact name on received messages.
configGeralPage.bsuidStrictModeDesc: Applies Meta's strict mode to the send checks. Contacts without a phone number already use the dedicated field automatically.
configGeralPage.forcarAdminDesc: Pending tickets will be assigned to admin.
configGeralPage.uazapiDisableLidDesc: When enabled, contacts received via UAZAPI with @lid will not be marked as isLid in the database.
configGeralPage.controleFeaturesDesc: When enabled, controls spy and forced closure features for users.
configGeralPage.forceReason: Force demand definition on attendance closure
configGeralPage.forceReasonDesc: When enabled, the system requires demand definition on attendance closure.
configGeralPage.allowPauseDesc: When enabled, attendance can be temporarily paused.
configGeralPage.offlineOnTabClose: Go offline when the tab is closed
configGeralPage.offlineOnTabCloseDesc: When enabled, closing the last open tab or window automatically marks the user as offline (same effect as the 'go offline' logout option). Reloading the page (F5) does not drop the status and other open tabs are taken into account. When disabled, closing the tab does not change the status (current behavior).
configGeralPage.autoUnpauseOnReplyDesc: When enabled, a paused attendance is automatically resumed as soon as the customer sends a new message; after the operator replies, it is paused again automatically, until the customer responds once more. When disabled, the attendance stays paused until the operator resumes it manually (current behavior).
configGeralPage.allowDuplicateMessagesDesc: When enabled, the same message received by more than one of the company's connections (e.g., two channels in the same group, or channels messaging each other) is recorded in each corresponding ticket. Note: automatic replies (chatbot, AI, rating) are blocked for messages coming from another connection of the same company to prevent loops; external integrations and webhooks will receive the message once per connection; and metrics count each copy. When disabled, only the first channel records the message (current behavior).
configGeralPage.contactEventsRetentionDaysDesc: How long to keep the events in the contact timeline (funnel, tags, wallet and profile).
configGeralPage.contactEventsRetentionNote: Events older than this period are deleted overnight and cannot be recovered. Conversations, messages and campaigns are not affected.
configGeralPage.groupTimeMetricsEnabledDesc: When enabled, group conversations are included in the report time averages (waiting and handling times). When disabled, groups are left out of these averages and their time columns appear blank in reports — ticket counts still include groups. Useful when group chats distort team indicators.
configGeralPage.botReopenGraceDesc: If the customer replies within the defined period after closing, the ticket reopens in Open assigned to the agent who handled it, skipping the chatbot. After the grace period, replies follow the normal flow (pending/chatbot).
configGeralPage.botReopenGraceScenarios:
How it works in practice:
• Open satisfaction survey: the score sent by the customer is recorded normally and the conversation stays closed.
• Conversation closed by the bot: it does not reopen — the customer's reply goes back to the bot.
• Closed from the list by someone else: it reopens for whoever closed it, not for the original agent.
• Agent offline: if automatic redistribution is on, the reopened conversation may go to another agent.
• Flow keyword: if the customer's reply contains a word that triggers a flow, the bot may take over the conversation even during the grace period.
• Does not work in groups or the webchat channel.
configGeralPage.universalCounterDesc: Shows open ticket counter on top tabs.
configGeralPage.pluginAudioDesc: When enabled, a new beta audio plugin will be used.
configGeralPage.audioModuloDesc: When enabled, a new audio module with sound waves will be used.
configGeralPage.persistirMediaDesc: When enabled, sequential attempts are made to download media received via Baileys.
configGeralPage.useUserBusinessHoursDesc: When enabled, the system uses user business hours.
configGeralPage.webPushChatInternoDesc: When enabled, push notifications are sent for new internal chat messages.
configGeralPage.pushNotificationLimitToOwnerDesc: By default, push notifications are delivered to: administrators (all), agents with permission for the ticket's WhatsApp connection and queue, and the agent assigned to the ticket. When enabled, notifications will be sent exclusively to the direct recipient of the message, regardless of profile.
configGeralPage.pushMessagePreviewDesc: When enabled, the notification shows the contact name and a snippet of the received message. When disabled, it shows only the contact name and a new message notice - suitable for teams that must keep customer content off the lock screen.
configGeralPage.pushDuplicateSuppression: Avoid repeated notification in the browser
configGeralPage.pushDuplicateSuppressionDesc: When enabled, people who have the app installed on their phone stop receiving the same notification in the browser as well, ending the duplicate alert. It applies only to those who opened the app in the last 7 days; anyone who stopped using it is notified in the browser again. Disabled by default.
configGeralPage.autoCloseDesc: Idle attendances will be automatically resolved.
configGeralPage.autoCloseChannelOverrideNote: Some channels can have their own inactivity-closing rule, set on the Connections screen. When a channel has its own rule, it applies instead of this general setting.
configGeralPage.ticketLimitDaysDesc: Attendances older than this number of days will be filtered.
configGeralPage.tentativasDesc: Number of times the absence message can be sent per attendance.
configGeralPage.limiteTickets: Number of tickets queried in attendances
configGeralPage.limiteTicketsDesc: Number of tickets to be fetched on the attendance screen.
configGeralPage.limiteChatInterno: Number of messages in internal chat per attendance
configGeralPage.limiteChatInternoDesc: Number of messages to be loaded in internal chat per attendance.
configGeralPage.forbiddenNumbersDesc: List of numbers blocked on the platform.
configGeralPage.helpDesc: These settings control who can see which tickets, how the list is sorted, and which rules apply to each user profile.
configGeralPage.helpS0T: Profiles and what each one sees
configGeralPage.helpS0I0: Administrators always see all tickets, regardless of any setting below
configGeralPage.helpS0I1: Supervisors: if 'Remove supervisor privileges' is OFF, the supervisor has the same view as admin. If ON, they follow the same rules as a regular user
configGeralPage.helpS0I2: Regular users see only tickets from their assigned queues, tickets assigned to them, and tickets from contacts in their wallet
configGeralPage.helpS1T: Do not view tickets assigned to others
configGeralPage.helpS1I0: When ON, regular users and supervisors (without privileges) see only: tickets assigned to themselves, unassigned tickets (within their queues), and groups where they were included
configGeralPage.helpS1I1: Administrators and supervisors with privileges ignore this rule - they always see all tickets, even when filtering by queue
configGeralPage.helpS1I2: If 'Show Closed for all' or 'Show Groups for all' are enabled, those tickets remain visible even with this option active
configGeralPage.helpS2I0: When ON, tickets still being processed by the chatbot (no assigned agent and no defined queue) are hidden from all users
configGeralPage.helpS2I1: This prevents the list from being cluttered with conversations the bot hasn't forwarded to human support yet
configGeralPage.helpS3T: Tickets without an owner and wallets
configGeralPage.helpS3I0: 'View tickets without user or queue': when ON, all users see tickets not yet assigned to anyone. When OFF, only administrators see them
configGeralPage.helpS3I1: 'Force wallet-based service': when ON, new tickets are automatically routed to the contact's wallet owner
configGeralPage.helpS3I2: Even if a ticket is not in your queue, you will see it if the contact is in your wallet
configGeralPage.helpS4I0: 'Show Groups for all': when OFF, regular users only see groups in their queues. When ON (or not set), everyone sees all groups
configGeralPage.helpS4I1: 'Show Closed for all': when OFF, only administrators can see closed tickets. When ON, everyone can view them
configGeralPage.helpS4I2: 'Ignore Group Messages': when ON, no group tickets appear in the list for any profile
configGeralPage.helpS5I0: Each supervisor can have 'View only my department' enabled in their user profile
configGeralPage.helpS5I1: When active, the supervisor sees only tickets from their assigned queues, even if they have admin privileges
configGeralPage.helpS6I0: Each user can have specific connections (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) defined in their profile
configGeralPage.helpS6I1: If the user has defined connections, they will only see tickets from those connections. Administrators always see all
configGeralPage.helpS7I0: 'Sort by last message': orders the list by the most recent message time, not by the ticket update date
configGeralPage.helpS7I1: 'Reverse order': shows the oldest tickets first instead of the most recent
configGeralPage.helpS7I2: 'Filter old tickets': hides tickets that had no activity within the configured number of days
configGeralPage.helpS8I0: When ON, the system only notifies the user about their own tickets, reducing processing in environments with many simultaneous messages
configGeralPage.helpS8I1: Administrators continue receiving notifications for all tickets, even with this option active
configGeralPage.helpS9I0: Admin: sees everything, always. No visibility setting restricts them
configGeralPage.helpS9I1: Supervisor without removed privileges: same view as admin
configGeralPage.helpS9I2: Supervisor with removed privileges: follows the same rules as a regular user
configGeralPage.helpS9I3: Regular user: sees tickets from their queues + assigned to them + their wallet. The options above restrict or expand this view
configGeralPage.helpS10I0: When a new ticket enters as pending, the system sends an automatic message to the customer informing their position in the queue and the configured average waiting time
configGeralPage.helpS10I1: The value set here is the tenant default for all channels. Each channel can override this in 'Channel Features' of the session (inherit / enable / disable)
configGeralPage.helpS10I2: The message is sent only once per ticket, after the chatbot/flow finishes. If the ticket is already assigned to an agent or a chatbot takes over, the message is not fired
configGeralPage.wabaCallRoutingDesc: Defines who rings when a customer calls via WABA
configGeralPage.wabaCallRoutingAssignedTicket: Only agent of the open ticket
configGeralPage.wabaCallFallbackSecondsDesc: After this time without an answer, rings the next agent in the queue
configGeralPage.windowTimerBannerDesc: Shows the 24h window countdown at the top of the chat on WABA, Hub, Instagram and Messenger channels
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerDesc: Shows the notice to use templates outside the 24h window at the top of the WABA chat
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerMsgDesc: Customize the message. Leave empty to use the default text
configGeralPage.wabaTemplateBannerMsgPlaceholder: WABA channel: use templates to start conversations outside the 24h window.
configGeralPage.windowClosedBannerDesc: Shows the notice that the 24h window has closed at the top of the chat (WABA, Instagram and Messenger channels). The send template button remains available in the actions menu
configGeralPage.directTicketsToContactQueue: Route tickets to the contact's Queue
configGeralPage.directTicketsToContactQueueDesc: New tickets from contacts that have a queue set in their profile automatically enter that queue.
configGeralPage.botReopenDestinationHint: When the customer replies shortly after the chat ends, choose where the conversation goes back to (the same agent, whoever closed it, a queue, a fixed agent or a chatbot) — without going through the initial menu.

customizarPage.socketModelWarningTitle: Warning: side effects of enabling optimized mode
customizarPage.socketModelWarningIntro: Optimized mode applies a 1.5s debounce and a 2s cache to ticket list socket events to reduce server queries. This can cause the following behaviors:
customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet1: Queue or user assignments made by chat flow may not appear immediately in the open ticket view. If the ticket is not in the current list (filter applied, not on page 1, or not assigned to the agent), the queue may only show after F5 or after leaving and reopening the ticket.
customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet2: Header and list field updates (queue, assigned user, status) may take up to 1.5s to reflect.
customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet3: Incoming messages, sends and read receipts (acks) remain real-time — the delay only affects the list/header of the ticket view.
customizarPage.socketModelWarningBullet4: F5, reopening the ticket, or a socket reconnect always fetch fresh state from the server.
customizarPage.socketModelWarningRecommendation: Recommended only for installations with more than 25 simultaneous users or more than 1500 tickets per day. For smaller environments, the standard mode offers instant updates with no performance cost.

chatFlowAudience.scheduleToggleDesc: When on, this flow's bot only replies within the time windows. Outside them it stays silent.
chatFlowAudience.scheduleNoWindows: No windows added. The bot runs at any time.
chatFlowAudience.enabledToggleDesc: When disabled, this flow follows the default behavior (no filtering)
chatFlowAudience.maxAgeDays: Consider as new if created within N days
chatFlowAudience.tagsIncludePlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
chatFlowAudience.tagsExcludePlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
chatFlowAudience.priorityHint: Higher value evaluated first on ties
chatFlowAudience.helpIntro: Each chatflow only triggers for contacts that pass all configured filters (AND between fields). When nothing is set, it applies to everyone.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceAll: Available for any contact — default behavior when no audience is configured.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceNew: Only for those who never opened a ticket in this tenant before (or were created within the configured time window below).
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceReturning: Only for those who have at least one previously closed ticket.
chatFlowAudience.helpAudienceCustom: Uses only the filters (tags, kanban, channels) without any newness criteria.
chatFlowAudience.helpMaxAgeDays: When set, defines how long (in days) since the contact was created they are still considered new. Empty = strict 'zero prior tickets' criteria.
chatFlowAudience.helpTagsInclude: The contact must have AT LEAST ONE of the listed tags. Empty = filter ignored.
chatFlowAudience.helpTagsExclude: The contact is rejected if they have ANY of the listed tags. Useful to block existing customers, for example.
chatFlowAudience.helpKanban: Restricts to a specific kanban column. 'Any column' = filter ignored.
chatFlowAudience.helpChannels: Restricts to selected channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc). Empty = all channels.
chatFlowAudience.helpPriority: When multiple chatflows pass the filters, the one with the highest priority wins. Ties broken by lower ID.
chatFlowAudience.helpHowItWorks: On every new ticket, the system iterates active chatflows by priority and picks the first one that passes all configured filters here. If none matches, it falls back to the channel's default chatflow — and if the default also has audience filters enabled, it only fires when the contact passes them; otherwise the conversation goes straight to your team, without the bot.
chatFlowAudience.helpOutOfAudience: If a flow with filters enabled ends up applied to a conversation whose contact is outside the audience, the bot releases the conversation to your team instead of staying silent. Business hours behave differently: outside the time windows the bot just goes quiet and resumes in the next window.
chatFlowAudience.helpKeyword: If the chatflow also has a trigger word, BOTH must match (logical AND): the message must contain the word AND the contact must pass this audience.

welcome.title: Welcome to the platform!

channels.title: Channels

oauthCustomDomainPage.title: Custom OAuth Domain
oauthCustomDomainPage.description: Configure a subdomain pointing to the OAuth proxy (CNAME) for white-label.
oauthCustomDomainPage.helpDesc: White-label: end users see your domain in the authorization dialog instead of oauth.techprovider.com.br.
oauthCustomDomainPage.howItWorks1: Create a CNAME pointing your chosen subdomain (e.g. oauth.yourcompany.com) to {hostname}.
oauthCustomDomainPage.howItWorks2: Click Validate to verify DNS has propagated.
oauthCustomDomainPage.howItWorks3: Save. The proxy will automatically use your domain in all tenant OAuth flows.
oauthCustomDomainPage.validateError: CNAME does not point to the proxy. Check DNS.
oauthCustomDomainPage.removeConfirm: Remove the custom domain? Flows will revert to oauth.techprovider.com.br.
oauthCustomDomainPage.errorCnameMismatch: CNAME does not point to the proxy. Configure DNS before saving.
oauthCustomDomainPage.warning1: After changing DNS, propagation may take up to 48h. TLS certificates are automatically issued via Caddy on the first HTTPS connection.
oauthCustomDomainPage.warning2: If the license expires or the CNAME stops pointing to the proxy, the domain will be automatically removed on revalidation (every 3 days).
oauthCustomDomainPage.warning3: After saving, update the Redirect URI registered at each provider (LinkedIn Developer, Google Cloud, TikTok DevPortal, etc.) to use the new domain.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretSectionDesc: Shared secret used by the backend when calling proxy registry endpoints (webhooks for Instagram, Messenger, WABA, WooCommerce, ML, OLX, LinkedIn, TikTok). Must match the proxy REGISTRY_SECRET.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretPlaceholder: Paste the 32+ character value (hex or base64)
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretHint: Minimum 32 characters. Applied to all tenants of this installation.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretTooShort: The secret must have at least 32 characters.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretMismatchTitle: Proxy secret differs from expected value
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretMismatchDesc: The current secret ({current}) does not match the canonical value ({expected}). Click "Reset" to restore the correct value.
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretMismatchConfirm: The current proxy secret does not match the expected value. Reset to the correct value?
oauthCustomDomainPage.secretMismatchKept: Divergent proxy secret was kept unchanged.
oauthCustomDomainPage.healthSectionDesc: Verifies that the proxy is responding, the license is valid, and the CNAME of the custom domain (if configured) is propagated.
oauthCustomDomainPage.healthFailed: Some checks failed. See details below.
oauthCustomDomainPage.healthNoCustomDomain: No custom domain configured — using default oauth.techprovider.com.br.

rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_NOT_CONFIGURED: Rocket.Chat has not been set up for your company yet.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the Rocket.Chat server. Check the address and whether the server is online.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_HOST_BLOCKED: This address cannot be used as a Rocket.Chat server.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ADMIN_AUTH: Rocket.Chat rejected the integration account: the access token was revoked or is wrong.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_PERMISSION: The integration account does not have enough permissions in Rocket.Chat. Use an account with the admin role.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_TOKEN_SECRET_MISSING: The access release secret is missing. Rocket.Chat 8 or newer requires the same value as the server's CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS_SECRET variable.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_TOKEN_SECRET_INVALID: Rocket.Chat refused to release access. Check that the secret matches the server's CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS_SECRET (on version 7, the server needs CREATE_TOKENS_FOR_USERS=true), that Rocket.Chat was restarted after setting the variable and that the integration account has the user-generate-access-token permission.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_USER_NOT_FOUND: You do not have a Rocket.Chat account yet and automatic creation is turned off. Ask the administrator to create your account with the same email you use in the panel.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: There is a Rocket.Chat account with your username or email that could not be confirmed as yours. For security, access was not released. Ask the administrator to check that account.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_IS_ADMIN: The Rocket.Chat account linked to your email is an administrator account. For security, administrator accounts sign in directly through Rocket.Chat.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED: The Rocket.Chat account with your email does not have a confirmed email yet. Ask the Rocket.Chat administrator to confirm the email of that account.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your Rocket.Chat account is deactivated. Ask the administrator to reactivate it.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_INVALID_USER_DATA: Rocket.Chat refused to create your account with the panel data (name, email or email domain).
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED: When changing the server address, enter the access token again and, if there is one, the access release secret.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_BLOCKED: Rocket.Chat does not allow being opened inside the panel. In Rocket.Chat, go to Administration > Settings > General and turn off Restrict access inside any Iframe.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_NOT_HTTPS: Rocket.Chat needs an https address to open inside the panel.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_RECEIVE_DISABLED: Rocket.Chat ignores the sign-in sent by the panel. In Iframe Integration, turn on Enable Receive and add this panel's address to Receive Origins (or use *), without spaces.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_IFRAME_SEND_DISABLED: Rocket.Chat does not tell the panel when sign-in finishes or when messages arrive. In Iframe Integration, turn on Enable Send and use this panel's address (or *) in Send Target Origin.
rocketChatErrors.ERR_RC_INTERNAL: Rocket.Chat could not be opened because of an error in the panel. Try again; if it persists, contact support.

bulkPhoneWarnings.title: Numbers possibly with wrong 9th digit
bulkPhoneWarnings.hint: These numbers will be sent as typed. If the correct contact already exists in the alternate form, a duplicate contact will be created.
bulkPhoneWarnings.duplicatesHint: Lines with the same recipient (after 9th-digit normalization). Duplicates are removed automatically before sending.
bulkPhoneWarnings.duplicatesHintMultiSend: Lines with the same recipient (after 9th-digit normalization). Each line produces a separate message (intentional use for different variables). If unintended, remove duplicates before sending.
bulkPhoneWarnings.behaviorInfo:
BR 9th-digit correction:
• Follows the company setting (Settings > General > Brazilian 9th digit convention).
• Area code rule: mobile DDD<30 with the 9; DDD>=30 without it; landlines untouched.
• Always with 9: mobile numbers always keep the 9th digit (never removed).
• Validate Contact off: numbers are never changed.

Behavior (all 4 bulk tabs):
• Duplicates (after normalization) are merged — you see which.
• Numbers diverging from the rule are flagged in a warning; send proceeds as typed.
• Variants of the same contact (with/without 9) are recognized as the same contact in the database.

instagramPkSanitize.title: Fix Instagram IGSID (>2^53)
instagramPkSanitize.description: Audits Instagram contacts with instagramPK corrupted by IEEE-754 overflow (>2^53) and corrects them by cross-referencing the Meta API.
instagramPkSanitize.warnBody:
This operation performs a direct UPDATE on Contacts.instagramPK.
Ensure you have a recent database backup before proceeding.
Meta API limit: ~200 req/h per token; large tenants may take minutes.
